questions.question: At which ground did Badgers record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Recreation Ground — largest win by runs of 146, against Kei on 2018/11/18.

questions.question: "Warriors" is the current name for which former provincial union?
Who has achieved the fifty and 3 wickets in a match double more times, Erné Webber or Micaela Andrews?
questions.explanation: Erné Webber: 1 times. Micaela Andrews: 2 times.

questions.question: At Wanderers, who holds the record for 'Most Wickets' (T20)?
Who holds the record for 'Most Catches (Fielding)' (List A)?
questions.explanation: Alexis le Breton holds it, with a total of 61.

questions.question: At which ground did Marilize Erasmus record their career-best bowling figures (3-18, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Khaya Majola Oval, against Kei on 2012/02/26.
